BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE generated_course (
    course_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    origin varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (origin = 'learning_planner'),
    course_fingerprint char(64) NOT NULL CHECK (course_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    fingerprint_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    goal_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    goal_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    language varchar(16) NOT NULL,
    planner_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    pedagogy_profile varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    presentation_style varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    generation_policy varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    plan_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(plan_json) = 'object'),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (origin, fingerprint_version, course_fingerprint)
);

CREATE TABLE generated_lesson (
    lesson_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES generated_course(course_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    module_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    section_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    lesson_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    targets_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(targets_json) = 'array'),
    prerequisites_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(prerequisites_json) = 'array'),
    transition_knowledge_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(transition_knowledge_json) = 'array'),
    pedagogy_strategies_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(pedagogy_strategies_json) = 'array'),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (course_id, module_code, section_code, lesson_code)
);

CREATE TABLE generated_course_request (
    idempotency_key uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    request_hash char(64) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES generated_course(course_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    reused boolean NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

COMMIT;
